properties.english_form: A burst must not cross a 4KB address boundary.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARREADY) |-> ((ARADDR[11:0] + ((ARLEN+1) << ARSIZE)) <= 13'h1000));

properties.english_form: When VALID is asserted, it must remain asserted until the handshake occurs (rising clock edge with VALID and READY both HIGH).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (AWVALID && !AWREADY) |=> AWVALID);

properties.english_form: The VALID signal of the AXI interface sending information must not be dependent on the READY signal of the AXI interface receiving that information. A source is not permitted to wait until READY is asserted before asserting VALID.
properties.sva_form: // Structural property — combinational path from READY to VALID is forbidden. Not directly expressible in SVA; checked by lint / interface review.

properties.english_form: On master and slave interfaces, there must be no combinatorial paths between input and output signals.
properties.sva_form: // Structural / synthesis lint rule; not expressible as a temporal SVA property.

properties.english_form: During reset (ARESETn LOW) a master interface must drive ARVALID, AWVALID, and WVALID LOW.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) !ARESETn |-> (!ARVALID && !AWVALID && !WVALID));

properties.english_form: During reset (ARESETn LOW) a slave interface must drive RVALID and BVALID LOW.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) !ARESETn |-> (!RVALID && !BVALID));

properties.english_form: The earliest point after reset that a master is permitted to begin driving ARVALID/AWVALID/WVALID HIGH is at a rising ACLK edge after ARESETn is HIGH.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) $rose(ARESETn) |-> !AWVALID); // earliest VALID is the next rising edge

properties.english_form: For wrapping bursts (AxBURST=WRAP), the burst length must be 2, 4, 8, or 16.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARBURST==2'b10) |-> (ARLEN inside {3'd1,3'd3,3'd7,3'd15}));
properties.citation: A3.4.1 page A3-48, A3.4 page A3-49 (WRAP definition)

properties.english_form: For WRAP bursts, the start address must be aligned to the size of each transfer (AxSIZE).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARBURST==2'b10) |-> ((ARADDR & ((1<<ARSIZE)-1)) == 0));

properties.english_form: Early termination of bursts is not supported. The master must complete the remaining transfers in the burst (it may deassert all WSTRB to suppress writing, but transfer count is fixed).
properties.sva_form: // Counted-beats property: after handshake of AW with ARLEN=N, exactly N+1 W beats with WLAST on the last must occur before BVALID.

properties.english_form: The size of any transfer (2^AxSIZE bytes) must not exceed the data bus width of either agent in the transaction.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) ARVALID |-> ((1<<ARSIZE) <= DATA_BUS_BYTES));

properties.english_form: AxBURST=2'b11 is Reserved and must not be used.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) ARVALID |-> (ARBURST != 2'b11));

properties.english_form: The slave must ensure that the RID value of any returned read data matches the ARID value of the address that it is responding to.
properties.sva_form: // Outstanding-transaction scoreboard: every RID seen must equal an outstanding ARID issued earlier.

properties.english_form: The BID value returned on the write response channel must match the AWID value of the corresponding write transaction.
properties.sva_form: // Outstanding-transaction scoreboard: every BID must match an outstanding AWID.
properties.citation: A5.2 page A5-81 (Table A5-1) and A5.2.1

properties.english_form: Read data from a sequence of transactions with the same ARID value targeting different slaves must be received by the master in the order that it issued the addresses.
properties.sva_form: // FIFO-per-ID property; checked by scoreboard.

properties.english_form: A master must issue write data in the same order that it issues the transaction addresses.
properties.sva_form: // FIFO ordering between AW and W; in AXI4 write data interleaving is removed.

properties.english_form: In AXI4, WID is not implemented. Write data interleaving is deprecated; write data must be in the same order as addresses.
properties.sva_form: // Structural: WID port must be absent in AXI4 master/slave interfaces.
properties.citation: A2.3 page A2-34, A5.2.2 page A5-81

properties.english_form: In AXI4 and AXI5, the slave must wait for AWVALID, AWREADY, WVALID, WREADY, AND WLAST to be asserted before asserting BVALID.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) $rose(BVALID) |-> $past(AWVALID && AWREADY) && $past(WVALID && WREADY && WLAST,1));

properties.english_form: In AXI3, the slave must wait for WVALID, WREADY, and WLAST to be asserted before asserting BVALID (AW handshake is not a precondition).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) $rose(BVALID) |-> $past(WVALID && WREADY && WLAST));

properties.english_form: The slave must wait for both ARVALID and ARREADY to be asserted before it asserts RVALID.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) $rose(RVALID) |-> $past(ARVALID && ARREADY,1));

properties.english_form: The master must not wait for the slave to assert AWREADY/ARREADY/WREADY before asserting the corresponding VALID.
properties.sva_form: // Structural: VALID combinational path from READY is forbidden.

properties.english_form: The slave must not wait for the master to assert BREADY/RREADY before asserting BVALID/RVALID.
properties.sva_form: // Structural: VALID combinational path from READY is forbidden.

properties.english_form: The address of an exclusive access must be aligned to the total number of bytes in the transaction (Burst_Length * Number_Bytes).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARLOCK==1) |-> ((ARADDR & (((ARLEN+1)<<ARSIZE)-1)) == 0));

properties.english_form: The number of bytes transferred in an exclusive burst must be a power of 2 (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, or 128).
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARLOCK==1) |-> ($onehot((ARLEN+1)<<ARSIZE)));

properties.english_form: The maximum number of bytes transferred in an exclusive burst is 128.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARLOCK==1) |-> (((ARLEN+1)<<ARSIZE) <= 128));

properties.english_form: The burst length for an exclusive access must not exceed 16 transfers.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (ARVALID && ARLOCK==1) |-> ((ARLEN+1) <= 16));

properties.english_form: For an exclusive read and an exclusive write to be considered part of the same exclusive sequence, AxID/AxADDR/AxREGION/AxLEN/AxSIZE/AxBURST/AxLOCK/AxCACHE/AxPROT (and AxDOMAIN/AxSNOOP/AxMMU* where present) must be identical.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: compare exclusive write transaction tuple against most recent exclusive read with same ID.

properties.english_form: The required number of data transfers must be performed even if an error is reported. A burst is not canceled if the slave gives an error response.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: number of W beats with WLAST and number of R beats with RLAST must equal AxLEN+1 regardless of any non-OKAY responses.

properties.english_form: For a write transaction, a single response is signaled for the entire burst, not for each data transfer.
properties.sva_form: // Scoreboard: exactly one BVALID handshake per AW transaction.

properties.english_form: EXOKAY responses are only legal as a response to an exclusive read or write.
properties.sva_form: assert property (@(posedge ACLK) disable iff (!ARESETn) (BVALID && BRESP==2'b01) |-> $past(exclusive_aw_outstanding));
properties.citation: A3.4 page A3-60, A7.2.5 page A7-98

properties.english_form: An exclusive read may have a mixture of EXOKAY/SLVERR/DECERR or OKAY/SLVERR/DECERR responses, but mixing EXOKAY and OKAY in the same exclusive transaction is not permitted.
properties.sva_form: // Per-transaction tracking: once first RRESP for the burst is EXOKAY, no subsequent RRESP in that burst may be OKAY (and vice versa).

properties.english_form: AXI uses byte-invariant endianness: a byte at a particular memory address is always at the same byte address, regardless of the endianness of any larger element it is part of.
properties.sva_form: // Architectural rule; structural compliance — checked by interconnect-realignment audit, not a per-cycle property.

properties.english_form: There is one write strobe for each 8 bits of write data; WSTRB[n] corresponds to WDATA[(8n+7):8n]. Write data bytes whose strobe is LOW must be ignored (either driven LOW or held at previous value).
properties.sva_form: // Per-byte property: assert that WDATA bytes with WSTRB=0 are don't-care at the slave.

properties.english_form: In AXI4, all Device transactions using the same ID to the same slave must be ordered with respect to each other.
properties.sva_form: // FIFO ordering property checked by scoreboard for Device-class (AxCACHE Non-modifiable) transactions.

properties.english_form: In an AXI4 environment, any AXI3 locked transaction (AxLOCK[1:0]=0b10) must be converted to a normal transaction (AxLOCK=0b0).
properties.sva_form: // Bridge-level transformation; checked at AXI3 boundary.

properties.english_form: Multi_Copy_Atomicity property must be True for Issue G and later of this specification. A system is multi-copy atomic iff writes to the same location are observed in the same order by all agents AND a write observable by one agent is observable by all agents.
properties.sva_form: // System-level property; not directly cycle-checkable. Validated by interconnect topology + cache-coherence proofs.

properties.english_form: If the interconnect cannot successfully decode a slave access, it must return the DECERR response. Recommendation: route to a default slave that returns DECERR.
properties.sva_form: // Interconnect-level address-decode property.

properties.english_form: A Non-modifiable transaction (AxCACHE Modifiable=0) must not be split or merged, and AxADDR, AxSIZE, AxLEN, AxBURST, AxLOCK, AxCACHE, AxPROT must not be changed by the interconnect.
properties.sva_form: // Interconnect transparency property.

properties.english_form: AXI4 INCR bursts with length >16 may be converted to multiple smaller bursts even if Non-modifiable; the generated bursts must retain the same transaction characteristics, except burst length is reduced and address is adapted.
properties.sva_form: // Interconnect transformation property; legal only for INCR with AxLEN >= 16.
properties.citation: A3.4 page A3-49, A4.3 page A4-64

evidence.quote: During reset a master interface must drive ARVALID, AWVALID, and WVALID LOW. A slave interface must drive RVALID and BVALID LOW. The earliest point after reset that a master is permitted to begin driving ARVALID, AWVALID, or WVALID HIGH is at a rising ACLK edge after ARESETn is HIGH.

A source is not permitted to wait until READY is asserted before asserting VALID. When VALID is asserted, it must remain asserted until the handshake occurs, at a rising clock edge when VALID and READY are both asserted.
The VALID signal of the AXI interface sending information must not be dependent on the READY signal of the AXI interface receiving that information.
The slave must wait for both WVALID and WREADY to be asserted before asserting BVALID. The slave must also wait for WLAST to be asserted before asserting BVALID.

evidence.spec_section: A3.3.1 AXI4 and AXI5 write transaction dependencies
evidence.quote: The slave must wait for AWVALID, AWREADY, WVALID, and WREADY to be asserted before asserting BVALID.

AXI has the following rules governing the use of bursts: For wrapping bursts, the burst length must be 2, 4, 8, or 16. A burst must not cross a 4KB address boundary. Early termination of bursts is not supported.

The size of any transfer must not exceed the data bus width of either agent in the transaction. Burst type WRAP: the start address must be aligned to the size of each transfer; the length of the burst must be 2, 4, 8, or 16 transfers.

evidence.spec_section: A3.4 Read and write response structure
evidence.quote: For a write transaction, a single response is signaled for the entire burst, and not for each data transfer within the burst. The protocol specifies that the required number of data transfers must be performed, even if an error is reported.

The slave must ensure that the RID value of any returned data matches the ARID value of the address that it is responding to. A master must issue write data in the same order that it issues the transaction addresses.

A system is defined as being multi-copy atomic if writes to the same location are observed in the same order by all agents. It is required that the Multi_Copy_Atomicity property is True for Issue G and later of this specification.

The address of an exclusive access must be aligned to the total number of bytes in the transaction. The number of bytes to be transferred in an exclusive access burst must be a power of 2. The maximum number of bytes that can be transferred in an exclusive burst is 128. The burst length for an exclusive access must not exceed 16 transfers.
Mixing EXOKAY and OKAY responses in the same transaction is not permitted.
